name: DistanceCuller
src_typeComment: Drop on anything expensive that doesn't need to run when far from the camera (a particle system, an AI's own Update loop, a complex animator) — disables the target Behaviour(s)/GameObject beyond a distance threshold and re-enables it when back in range. Simple LOD-lite without needing Unity's LOD Group.

src_serialized.name: referencePoint
src_serialized.tooltip: Distance from the reference point beyond which the target is disabled. Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_serialized.name: targetBehaviours
src_serialized.tooltip: Component(s) to enable/disable based on distance (scripts, Camera, Light, ParticleSystem...). Note: Renderer is NOT a Behaviour in Unity's API, so use targetRenderers below to cull visibility.

src_serialized.name: targetRenderers
src_serialized.tooltip: Renderer(s) to enable/disable based on distance — the usual case for visual LOD-lite culling (MeshRenderer, SkinnedMeshRenderer...).

src_serialized.name: targetGameObjects
src_serialized.tooltip: GameObject(s) to activate/deactivate based on distance — more aggressive than disabling components (stops rendering too). Put this DistanceCuller on a DIFFERENT, always-active object (e.g. a parent) rather than one of these — disabling an object this script is itself on would also stop its own Update, permanently freezing it culled with no way to re-enable.

src_serialized.name: cullDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: Distance from referencePoint beyond which the target(s) are disabled.

src_serialized.name: checkInterval
src_serialized.tooltip: How often (seconds) to re-check distance. 0 = every frame.
